summary: Learn to guide team ideas into bounded experiments using SCAMPER and Lean Startup methods. Explore the five-day course and its practical outputs.
lede: Innovative team leadership helps team leads, project supervisors, and improvement specialists turn challenges into bounded tests and evidence-based decisions. Participants practise framing challenges, setting decision rights, and using SCAMPER and Six Thinking Hats to select ideas. They also use the Lean Startup Build-Measure-Learn cycle to plan small experiments, capture feedback, and review findings to guide next steps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who guide teams responsible for proposing, testing, or implementing improvements. It suits foundation-level learners who need practical methods for structuring idea work and making team decisions.
modules: Six Thinking Hats for Team Decisions
prerequisites: No specific prerequisites required. Basic professional experience recommended.
